sources.title: Nordic bank Nordea to cut 1,500 staff | Macau Business
sources.description: International, MNA | Nordea, the largest bank in the Nordics, said Tuesday that it was cutting some 1,500 staff as part of a cost-cutting programme.

sources.title: Nordea bank to cut 5% of staff, expecting AI cost savings
sources.description: Nordic bank Nordea has announced it is looking to cut up to 1,500 jobs over the next year on the basis of efficiency savings from AI.

sources.title: KEY POINTS: Which major Danish companies have announced job cuts in 2026?
sources.description: Companies in Denmark have announced significant job cuts effective in 2026, with shipping giant Maersk among those whose staff are affected.
